en: The only prerequisite is Python 3.9 or newer (on macOS, plus two Homebrew libraries shown below). Works on macOS, Windows and Linux; no pipx, git or PATH changes needed.
zh: 唯一前提是 Python 3.9 或更新版本（macOS 另需下面列出的两个 Homebrew 库）。适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux；不需要 pipx、git，也不需要修改 PATH。

en: macOS uses a private environment at ~/.sp-streetlevel, so this does not upgrade packages inside Anaconda or conda base. Reinstall with the command below, then restart serve and approve the certificate prompt. Safari on https://sp-survey.org uses https://127.0.0.1:47822.
zh: macOS 使用 ~/.sp-streetlevel 私有环境，因此不会升级 Anaconda 或 conda base 里的包。请用下面的命令重新安装，然后重启 serve 并批准证书提示。在 Safari 中打开 https://sp-survey.org 时，面板通过 https://127.0.0.1:47822 连接。

en: This leaves Anaconda and conda base alone. Installing with pip --user there can upgrade cryptography and break conda’s pyopenssl.
zh: 这样不会改动 Anaconda 或 conda base。在那里使用 pip install --user 可能升级 cryptography，导致 conda 自带的 pyopenssl 无法使用。

en: If python3 -m sp_streetlevel serve already works on this computer, keep using it:
zh: 如果这台电脑上 python3 -m sp_streetlevel serve 已经能用，继续用它：

en: The panel calls https://127.0.0.1:47822/health first, then http://127.0.0.1:47821/health.
zh: 面板先请求 https://127.0.0.1:47822/health，再请求 http://127.0.0.1:47821/health。

zh: 本地工具已在运行，但浏览器拦截了连接。请使用下面的备用命令。

en: Why: streetlevel depends on pyexiv2, whose bundled libexiv2 on macOS is linked against Homebrew’s gettext and inih. Without them the helper stops at start with “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”. Not needed on Windows or Linux. No Homebrew? Get it at brew.sh.
zh: 原因：streetlevel 依赖 pyexiv2，它在 macOS 上自带的 libexiv2 链接了 Homebrew 的 gettext 和 inih；缺少时本地工具一启动就会报 “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”。Windows 和 Linux 不需要这一步。没有 Homebrew？请到 brew.sh 安装。

Google 街景（无需 key，默认）

en: All map, road, area and grid points share these settings; points from pasted Street View URLs keep their own heading, pitch and FOV.
zh: 地图、沿路、区域和网格点位共用这些设置；来自粘贴街景网址的点位保留各自的 heading、pitch 和 FOV。

en: Google Street View via streetlevel uses unofficial Google endpoints and conflicts with Google’s terms. Runs on your computer; see Download settings.
zh: 通过 streetlevel 下载 Google 街景使用的是 Google 非官方接口，与 Google 条款冲突。在你的电脑上运行；详见“下载设置”。

en: Mapillary images are CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution is saved with every file.
zh: Mapillary 影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可，每个文件都会保存署名。

en: Mapillary uses its official Graph API with your own free access token. Images are CC BY-SA 4.0: the contributor and a link are saved with each file and in features/street_level_v1.csv; keep that attribution when you publish them.
zh: Mapillary 使用官方 Graph API 和你自己的免费 access token。影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0：每个文件及 features/street_level_v1.csv 中都保存了贡献者和链接，发布时请保留署名。

en: Mapillary needs a free access token. Paste it in Download settings, or switch back to Google Street View, which needs no key.
zh: Mapillary 需要免费 access token。请在“下载设置”中填写，或改回无需 key 的 Google 街景。

zh: 命令行方式请先设置 token：MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（macOS / Linux）或 set MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（Windows）。

zh: 没有 python3？请从 python.org/downloads 安装 Python；使用 Homebrew 的话也可以运行 brew install python。

en: No py command? Install Python from python.org/downloads (the installer adds the py launcher).

en: Downloads use the open-source streetlevel library, which reads Google Street View through the unofficial endpoints of Google’s own viewer. This is not an official Google API, and it goes against Google’s terms, which forbid downloading and storing Street View images, including for research. It runs on your computer and under your responsibility; the platform only receives the finished files.
zh: 下载使用开源的 streetlevel 库，它通过 Google 自家查看器的非官方接口读取 Google 街景。这不是 Google 官方 API，并且违反 Google 条款（条款禁止下载和保存街景图像，研究用途也不例外）。下载在你的电脑上进行，由你自行承担责任；平台只接收最终生成的图片文件。

zh: 当前抽图规则没有足够的匹配媒体完成所有轮次，请检查文件夹、分组、分类或去重设置。

en: Preview could not load. Edit the question or reopen the preview.
zh: 预览加载失败，请修改题目或重新打开预览。

en: Clear answers and restart at the first trial. Random media is resampled; manual selections stay fixed.
zh: 清空试答并回到第一轮；随机题重新抽图，手动指定的图片保持不变。

en: Rendered at device width, then scaled to fit. Scroll and try answers inside; editing resets preview answers. Results are not saved.
zh: 按设备实际宽度排版，缩放仅用于适应此面板；可在预览内滚动和试答。修改设置会重置试答，不保存结果。

en: Choose a standard output, then customize the interaction. Built-in tasks are available directly in Survey Builder. Each custom interaction handles one task; the platform provides analysis and export.
zh: 先选标准输出，再定制交互。内置题型可在问卷编辑器直接使用；这里用于特殊交互。每个交互完成一项任务，平台统一分析与导出。

en: Custom interactions currently save one result per question. Use separate questions when each round needs its own record.
zh: 自定义交互目前每题保存一次结果。需要多轮记录时请拆题，不要在 HTML 内覆盖前几轮答案。
起步模板（切换会重置尚未保存的代码）

en: After changing settings, test again. Match the interaction’s controls to these settings in the advanced editor or with Codex.
zh: 修改设置后请重新试答；代码中的量程和选项也应相符，可在高级编辑或交给 Codex 修改。

en: This interaction does not require media.
This action leaves the editor or replaces the starter. Keep editing to retain unsaved content.
zh: 此操作会离开编辑器或替换当前模板。继续编辑可保留未保存的内容。

en: Media failed to load. Please retry.
Loading media. The timer has not started…
zh: 正在加载媒体，尚未开始计时…

en: Viewing time is over — please answer based on your impression.
zh: 展示结束，请根据刚才的印象作答。

en: Some historical responses have no recorded question definitions. Their original settings cannot be fully restored; analysis may use current settings as a reference. Verify against raw JSON.
zh: 部分历史答卷没有保存题目定义，无法还原当时的全部设置。当前分析可能使用现有题目作为参考，请结合原始 JSON 复核。

en: This attempt is kept unchanged on this page. Retry submission to confirm it without creating a duplicate.
zh: 本次答案已在当前页面保留。请重试提交以确认保存，不会重复新增记录。

en: Click a count to inspect images. Annotation and review cover the library; scores use the selected question; analyzable and missing features use current filters.
zh: 点击数量查看具体图片。标注与审核统计全库；评分对应所选题目；可分析与缺特征遵循当前筛选。

en: These historical scores cannot be matched to current media. Check their source records; filenames are never merged automatically.
zh: 这些历史评分无法确定对应的当前媒体。请核对来源记录；系统不会按文件名自动合并。

en: Open the source to inspect it, or go to its annotation when available. Missing scores require responses to the selected question.
zh: 可打开原始媒体核对；有权限时可直接进入该图片的标注。缺评分需通过对应题目收集回答。

en: Search filename, folder or media ID
zh: 搜索文件名、文件夹或媒体 ID

en: Submissions are not enabled yet. Please try again later.
zh: 投稿功能尚未启用，请稍后再试。

en: The content or review status changed. Reopen the submission or load the latest document and merge your changes.
zh: 内容或审核状态已改变。请重新打开申请，或载入最新文档后合并修改。

en: The document could not be found.
Submitted. Publication requires administrator review. Track status and feedback below.
zh: 已提交。管理员审核后才会发布；你可以在下方查看状态和反馈。

en: Latest source loaded. Your proposal is preserved; compare it with the source below and merge before resubmitting.
zh: 已载入最新原文。你的提案仍在编辑框中；请与下方原文比较、手动合并后重新提交。

en: Help build SP-Wiki: edit documentation, share template tutorials or introduce your research. Any signed-in user can submit; administrators review before publication.
zh: 一起建设 SP-Wiki：修改文档、分享模板教程或介绍研究成果。任何登录用户都可以投稿，管理员审核后公开发布。

en: Sign in to submit and track your contributions.
zh: 请登录后提交和查看自己的申请。

en: Start a new contribution and clear the editor?
zh: 开始新投稿会清空当前编辑框，是否继续？

en: Change language and clear the editor?
zh: 切换语言会清空当前编辑框，是否继续？

en: Change document and clear the editor?
zh: 切换文档会清空当前编辑框，是否继续？

en: Displayed publicly with an approved article.
zh: 审核通过后随文章公开展示。

en: Headings, tables, links and image URLs are supported. The platform provides template previews, live settings and scoring tools. Keep access keys and participant personal data out of the text.
zh: 支持标题、表格、链接和图片链接。模板预览、实时设置和计分组件由平台提供。不要粘贴访问密钥或参与者个人信息。
修改说明 / 投稿说明（仅审核可见）
来源与素材授权说明（仅审核可见）

en: Include reader-facing references and DOIs in the article too. Use public image URLs you have permission to share.
zh: 正文中也应保留读者需要的引用和 DOI。图片请使用可公开访问、获授权的链接。

en: I have permission to contribute this text and media and agree to publication under the name above after review.
zh: 我确认有权提交这些文字和素材，并同意审核通过后以所填署名公开发布。
载入最新原文以合并修改

en: Open this submission and replace the editor?
zh: 打开此申请会替换当前编辑框，是否继续？
标注与图像特征 × 感知

en: Choose a perception question, check feature–score matching, then analyze and export.
zh: 选择感知题目，检查标注与评分的对应关系，再分析和导出。

en: Feature loading failed. Analysis and export paused:
zh: 特征加载失败，已暂停分析与导出：

en: Exploratory analysis uses current annotations and features, not a feature snapshot frozen with the questionnaire. Coverage removes overlaps; box area is not segmented object area. Group-level ratings are excluded from per-image analysis.
zh: 探索性分析：使用当前标注和图像特征，不会随问卷版本自动冻结。标注覆盖率去除重叠；矩形框面积不等于物体分割面积。成组评分不能归给单张图片，因此不纳入单图分析。

en: Some legacy features have no source annotations and cannot be rebuilt or assigned verified zeros. Review before formal analysis.
zh: 部分旧特征缺少原始标注，无法重算覆盖率或确认零值；请核对后再用于正式分析。

en: Some historical scores do not match current media. Original identities are retained; same-name images are not guessed.
zh: 部分历史评分无法对应当前媒体。已保留原始身份，不会按同名图片强行匹配。

en: Stars use BH-FDR adjusted p-values across all tested features. Small samples and repeated ratings require caution; not causal.
zh: 星号使用全部特征的 BH-FDR 校正 p 值；小样本及重复评分需谨慎解释，不表示因果。

en: Tested on participant-level agreement with the pooled ranking (pairwise) or participant mean ratings (ratings). Exploratory.
zh: 检验对象：每位参与者与总体排名一致的比例（两两比较），或参与者平均评分（评分题）。仅供探索。

en: Reverse-coded wording: the chosen image counts as the loser.
zh: 本题为反向措辞：被选中的图计为输家。

en: Min–max scaling is relative to this sample and not comparable across studies.
zh: 最小–最大缩放只相对于当前样本，不能跨研究比较。

en: Export long format (one row per choice)
zh: 导出长表（每次选择一行）

en: participant(s) always chose the same side (≥5 trials)
zh: 位参与者始终选同一侧（≥5 次）

en: below the minimum number of ratings
Needs at least 2 raters who rated the same 2+ stimuli.
zh: 需要至少 2 位评分者共同评过至少 2 个刺激物。

en: Add a second annotation question (e.g. "disliked") to build an evaluative map.
zh: 需要另一道标注题（如"不喜欢"）才能生成综合评价地图。

en: No media available to pick from.
No category folders tagged yet (or none match this filter). Tag folders as category in Media Dataset.
zh: 尚未标记分类文件夹，或没有符合筛选条件的分类。请在媒体库中将文件夹标记为“分类”。

en: Prefer unused media; if the filtered pool is too small, fall back to the unfiltered range
zh: 优先不重复已展示的媒体；范围内不足时会回退到该范围未过滤池

en: Shown only for two options in single-select mode. Ties are counted separately; TrueSkill uses decisive answers only.
zh: 仅在展示两个选项且为单选时显示。平局单独统计，现有 TrueSkill 排名仅使用明确胜负。

en: Leave blank to follow the survey language.
zh: 留空时跟随问卷语言自动显示。
参与者预览（修改设置后自动更新）

en: The Assistant stays on the same layer so unsaved settings remain.
zh: 助手与题目设置同层，不会挡住未保存内容。

en: Your question settings have not been saved. Keep editing to retain them.
zh: 题目设置尚未保存。继续编辑可保留当前内容。

en: Media uploaded, but saving the media list failed. Retry saving.
zh: 媒体已上传，但媒体清单保存失败，请重试保存。

en: Folder uploads keep the selected folder name and subfolders inside the current directory. Only media files are imported; empty folders are omitted.
zh: 文件夹上传会保留所选文件夹名称和子文件夹层级，放入当前目录。仅导入媒体文件；空文件夹不会导入。

en: Compress large images for faster loading (keep original GIFs)
zh: 压缩大图以加快加载（GIF 保留原文件）

en: Uncheck when original pixels matter. Original files: up to 40 MB. Same-name files are stored separately.
zh: 研究需要原始像素时取消勾选；原文件最大 40 MB。同名文件会分别保存。

en: Use the up/down buttons or drag the handle (touch: press and hold), or confirm the current order.
zh: 点击上下箭头或拖动手柄调整顺序（手机上长按拖动），也可以确认当前顺序。

en: A data-format example, not a real answer. Multi-trial questions save each answer with its shown media. Run the full assignment check on Share Survey.
zh: 这是数据格式示例，不是真实答案。多轮题会逐轮保存答案及当时展示的媒体。完整分配检查在“分享问卷”页运行。

en: Complete the media/task settings and verify the answer in participant preview.
zh: 请先补齐媒体或任务设置，再通过参与者预览验证答案。

en: Separate keywords with commas, semicolons or newlines. Case-insensitive; spaces stay within phrases.
zh: 多个关键词用逗号、分号或换行分隔，不区分大小写；空格保留为词组。
整个媒体库（含所有子文件夹）

en: Matches image filenames, not visual content. Uses the criteria in this dialog and keeps your existing selection.
zh: 仅匹配图片文件名，不识别画面内容；使用这里的查找条件，保留已有勾选。

en: Enter keywords to see matching images.
zh: 输入关键词后查看匹配图片。

en: Previewing the first 12; confirmation selects all matches.
zh: 仅预览前 12 张，确认后选中全部匹配图片。

en: Analysis and export below use only this test answer. No response is saved; one test answer cannot establish statistical reliability.
zh: 以下仅使用本次试答展示正式分析与导出，不会保存答卷。单条试答不能说明统计可靠性。

en: Each participant is randomly assigned to one condition, keeping the groups balanced. With two or more conditions, each question can use different wording per condition (in question settings).
zh: 每位参与者会被随机分到其中一个条件，各条件人数自动保持平衡。添加至少两个条件后，可以在题目设置里为每个条件写不同的题干。

en: Add at least two conditions to enable assignment.
zh: 至少需要两个条件才会分组。

en: e.g. site or pid, comma-separated. When a participant link contains ?site=S01 the value is recorded (exported as url_site). The Share tab builds one link and QR code per value.
zh: 例如 site 或 pid，用逗号分隔。参与者链接里带上 ?site=S01 时会记录这个值（导出为 url_site 列）。在「分享」页可以为每个取值生成专属链接和二维码。

en: This survey has experimental conditions: everyone opens the same link above and is randomly assigned. No separate links are needed.
zh: 本问卷设置了实验条件：每位参与者打开上面的同一个链接时会被随机分到一个条件，不需要为不同条件准备不同的链接。

en: Links with parameters (one per site or channel)
zh: 带参数的链接（每个地点 / 渠道一个链接）

en: Recovered unsaved annotations. Retry saving to sync them.
zh: 有尚未保存的标注，已恢复。请点击重试保存。

en: Question numbers match the list below. Every selected condition must match.
zh: 题号与下方题目列表一致。多个条件要同时满足。

en: Configuration errors or missing media prevent release. Fix the Share Survey check first. Released studies cannot depend on the preview media library.
zh: 配置错误或媒体不足，不能发布。请先修复分享页试运行报告中的问题；正式版本不能依赖临时预览媒体库。

en: Question order, pages or survey settings may also differ.
zh: 题目顺序、分页或问卷设置也可能发生变化。

en: If a column or function is missing, apply research_releases.sql first. For other errors, refresh and retry.
zh: 若提示列或函数不存在，请先应用 research_releases.sql；其他错误请刷新重试。

en: Not enabled: saves still update the share link. Your first release separates drafts from the participant version.
zh: 尚未启用：保存仍立即影响分享链接。首次发布后启用草稿与正式版本分离。

en: Save your current changes, then refresh versions.
zh: 请先保存当前修改，再刷新版本。

en: Fix draft configuration errors in Survey Builder before releasing.
zh: 草稿存在配置错误，请先在题目设置中修复。

en: No earlier version loaded; compared with an empty baseline
zh: 当前列表无上一版本，按空白基线显示

en: Legacy snapshot has no media manifest; it can be inspected but not fully restored.
zh: 历史快照未记录媒体清单，仅可查看，不能完整恢复。

en: New participants will receive this version. Started responses keep their existing questions and media; history is retained.
zh: 这会更新新参与者看到的问卷。已经开始的答卷继续使用原有题目与媒体；历史记录会保留。

en: Restoring also replaces the current draft and media organization.
zh: 恢复还会替换当前草稿和媒体分类。
发出问卷前，先试跑一次

en: Check media assignment, trials and example-answer exports. Test data stays in this browser and is never submitted.
zh: 检查媒体分配、轮数及示例答案的分析导出。只在浏览器生成测试数据，不保存为正式答卷。

en: This does not fetch media, execute custom HTML, or predict real answers or completion time. Also test the participant preview.
zh: 此检查不验证媒体能否实际打开、不执行自定义 HTML、不预测真实回答或完成时间。正式分享前仍需体验参与者预览。

en: Download test report with simulated answers
zh: 下载测试报告（含模拟答卷）

en: A/B refer to the first/second stimulus in each recorded media list. Ties are valid answers counted separately; TrueSkill uses decisive outcomes only and excludes ties.
zh: A/B 对应每条记录中展示媒体的第一/第二项。平局是有效回答，单独统计；TrueSkill 排名仅使用明确胜负，不包含平局。

en: Saved changes update the live survey.
zh: 保存后即更新参与者问卷。

en: This survey has no answerable questions. Add questions before inviting participants.
zh: 问卷还没有作答题，请先在题目设置中完善。

en: There are unsaved changes. Wait for the toolbar to show saved before sending the share link.
zh: 当前有未保存的修改。请确认顶部显示已保存，再发送分享链接。

en: ⚠️ The draft changed after this review, so the revision was not applied. Run the review again.
zh: ⚠️ 评审后草稿已被修改，未应用修订。请重新运行评审。
媒体加载失败，点击重试
唯一前提是 Python 3.9 或更新版本（macOS 另需下面列出的两个 Homebrew 库）。适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux；不需要 pipx、git，也不需要修改 PATH。
gloss: The only prerequisite is Python 3.9 or newer (on macOS, plus two Homebrew libraries shown below). Works on macOS, Windows and Linux; no pipx, git or PATH changes needed.

zh: macOS 使用 ~/.sp-streetlevel 私有环境，因此不会升级 Anaconda 或 conda base 里的包。请用下面的命令重新安装，然后重启 serve 并批准证书提示。在 Safari 中打开 https://sp-survey.org 时，面板通过 https://127.0.0.1:47822 连接。
gloss: macOS uses a private environment at ~/.sp-streetlevel, so this does not upgrade packages inside Anaconda or conda base. Reinstall with the command below, then restart serve and approve the certificate prompt. Safari on https://sp-survey.org uses https://127.0.0.1:47822.

zh: 这样不会改动 Anaconda 或 conda base。在那里使用 pip install --user 可能升级 cryptography，导致 conda 自带的 pyopenssl 无法使用。
gloss: This leaves Anaconda and conda base alone. Installing with pip --user there can upgrade cryptography and break conda’s pyopenssl.

zh: 如果这台电脑上 python3 -m sp_streetlevel serve 已经能用，继续用它：
gloss: If python3 -m sp_streetlevel serve already works on this computer, keep using it:

zh: 面板先请求 https://127.0.0.1:47822/health，再请求 http://127.0.0.1:47821/health。
gloss: The panel calls https://127.0.0.1:47822/health first, then http://127.0.0.1:47821/health.

zh: 本地工具已在运行，但浏览器拦截了连接。请使用下面的备用命令。
gloss: The helper is running, but this browser blocked the connection. Use the backup command below.

zh: 原因：streetlevel 依赖 pyexiv2，它在 macOS 上自带的 libexiv2 链接了 Homebrew 的 gettext 和 inih；缺少时本地工具一启动就会报 “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”。Windows 和 Linux 不需要这一步。没有 Homebrew？请到 brew.sh 安装。
gloss: Why: streetlevel depends on pyexiv2, whose bundled libexiv2 on macOS is linked against Homebrew’s gettext and inih. Without them the helper stops at start with “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”. Not needed on Windows or Linux. No Homebrew? Get it at brew.sh.

zh: 沿道路四个方向（前 / 右 / 后 / 左）
gloss: Four road directions (front / right / back / left)

zh: Google 街景（无需 key，默认）
地图、沿路、区域和网格点位共用这些设置；来自粘贴街景网址的点位保留各自的 heading、pitch 和 FOV。
gloss: All map, road, area and grid points share these settings; points from pasted Street View URLs keep their own heading, pitch and FOV.

zh: 通过 streetlevel 下载 Google 街景使用的是 Google 非官方接口，与 Google 条款冲突。在你的电脑上运行；详见“下载设置”。
gloss: Google Street View via streetlevel uses unofficial Google endpoints and conflicts with Google’s terms. Runs on your computer; see Download settings.

zh: Mapillary 影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可，每个文件都会保存署名。
gloss: Mapillary images are CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution is saved with every file.

zh: Mapillary 使用官方 Graph API 和你自己的免费 access token。影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0：每个文件及 features/street_level_v1.csv 中都保存了贡献者和链接，发布时请保留署名。
gloss: Mapillary uses its official Graph API with your own free access token. Images are CC BY-SA 4.0: the contributor and a link are saved with each file and in features/street_level_v1.csv; keep that attribution when you publish them.

zh: Mapillary 需要免费 access token。请在“下载设置”中填写，或改回无需 key 的 Google 街景。
gloss: Mapillary needs a free access token. Paste it in Download settings, or switch back to Google Street View, which needs no key.

zh: Mapillary 需要免费的 client token，Google 街景不需要。只保存在本浏览器中，只发送给你的本地工具。获取地址：
gloss: Mapillary needs a free client token; Google Street View does not. Stored only in this browser and sent only to your local helper. Get one at

zh: 命令行方式请先设置 token：MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（macOS / Linux）或 set MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（Windows）。
gloss: For the command line, set the token first: MAPILLARY_TOKEN=… (macOS / Linux) or set MAPILLARY_TOKEN=… (Windows).

zh: 如果 pip 提示 “externally-managed-environment”（Homebrew 或 Debian/Ubuntu 自带的 Python），请改用独立环境：
gloss: If pip says “externally-managed-environment” (Homebrew or Debian/Ubuntu Python), use a private environment instead:

zh: 没有 python3？请从 python.org/downloads 安装 Python；使用 Homebrew 的话也可以运行 brew install python。
gloss: No python3? Install Python from python.org/downloads, or run brew install python if you use Homebrew.

zh: 没有 py 命令？请从 python.org/downloads 安装 Python（安装程序会附带 py 启动器）。
gloss: No py command? Install Python from python.org/downloads (the installer adds the py launcher).

zh: 没有 python3？用系统包管理器安装（例如 sudo apt install python3 python3-venv），或从 python.org/downloads 获取。
gloss: No python3? Install it with your package manager (e.g. sudo apt install python3 python3-venv) or from python.org/downloads.

zh: 在 Google Maps 窗口中选好视角，复制地址栏网址粘贴到这里；该点位会保留自己的 heading、pitch 和 FOV。
gloss: Choose a view in the Google Maps window, copy the address bar URL and paste it here; that point keeps its own heading, pitch and FOV.

zh: 粘贴一条 Google 街景网址。它会替换该点位的 heading、pitch、FOV 和全景 id。
gloss: Paste one Google Street View URL. It replaces this point’s heading, pitch, FOV and panorama id.

zh: 不是 Google Maps 网址
街景全景为 360°：视角图在你的电脑上由全景重投影生成；“完整全景”保存拼接后的等距柱状图。
gloss: Street View panoramas are 360°: views are re-projected from the panorama on your computer; “Full panorama” saves the stitched equirectangular image.

zh: 下载使用开源的 streetlevel 库，它通过 Google 自家查看器的非官方接口读取 Google 街景。这不是 Google 官方 API，并且违反 Google 条款（条款禁止下载和保存街景图像，研究用途也不例外）。下载在你的电脑上进行，由你自行承担责任；平台只接收最终生成的图片文件。
gloss: Downloads use the open-source streetlevel library, which reads Google Street View through the unofficial endpoints of Google’s own viewer. This is not an official Google API, and it goes against Google’s terms, which forbid downloading and storing Street View images, including for research. It runs on your computer and under your responsibility; the platform only receives the finished files.
